summary.what_broke: Clients cannot connect to the checkout API over HTTPS because the certificate on the load balancer expired.
summary.impact: Callers of checkout.example.com get certificate errors since 12:00; the application itself is healthy.
summary.scope: Every HTTPS client of checkout.example.com is affected; the service, its targets, and its logs are normal.

symptoms: Clients report certificate errors when calling checkout.example.com
The application shows no errors and all targets are healthy

causes.label: confirmed
causes.statement: The certificate on the HTTPS listener of the load balancer checkout-prod expired at 12:00:00, so clients reject the TLS connection

causes.label: candidate
causes.statement: The routine deployment of checkout-api:41 broke the service

hypotheses.statement: The certificate of the listener has expired
hypotheses.prediction: The certificate status is EXPIRED and its end time is at the impact start
hypotheses.test: Read the certificate behind the HTTPS listener

hypotheses.statement: The deployment of checkout-api:41 broke the service
hypotheses.test: Compare the deployment time and the service state with the impact start

actions.label: recommended
actions.title: Replace the expired certificate on the HTTPS listener
actions.current_state: The HTTPS listener of checkout-prod uses an ACM certificate with status EXPIRED
actions.required_state: The listener uses a valid certificate for checkout.example.com
actions.change: Request or import a valid certificate for checkout.example.com in ACM and attach it to the HTTPS listener of checkout-prod
actions.rationale: Clients reject the expired certificate; nothing else in the service is unhealthy
actions.risk: A wrong certificate would break HTTPS for every client
preconditions: The domain of checkout.example.com can be validated
verification: A TLS client connecting to checkout.example.com sees a valid certificate
The health check of checkout.example.com passes
rollback: Attach the previous certificate to the listener again

actions.label: candidate
actions.title: Renew certificates automatically and alarm before they expire
actions.current_state: The certificate expired without any warning
actions.required_state: ACM renews the certificate, and an alarm fires 30 days before any certificate expires
actions.change: Use an ACM certificate with DNS validation and add a certificate expiry alarm
actions.rationale: The failure was predictable from the certificate end date
actions.risk: Validation records must stay in place
verification: ACM shows the certificate as eligible for renewal

open_questions: Why was the certificate not renewed, and who owned its renewal?

not_checked.what: Certificates on other listeners or services
not_checked.why: Only the certificates of checkout-prod were read
